title: Empava — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Empava.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Quality Without the Markup." Value tier. Empava makes built-in cooktops, range hoods, and wall ovens at aggressive prices through online channels. Their gas and induction cooktops offer legitimate cooking performance at 50-70% below name brands. Growing fast on Amazon and through online kitchen retailers.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Online shoppers building kitchens on a budget. DIY renovators. Value-conscious buyers who research specs over brands.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Empava:

• Induction cooktops under $400 — best entry point into induction cooking

• Built-in gas cooktops at fraction of Bosch/KitchenAid pricing

• Strong Amazon reviews validate the value proposition

• Surprisingly good build quality for the price

• Perfect for budget kitchen renovations
